title: Asymptotic and Arithmetic Aspects of Generalized Colored Overpartitions
summary: Colored partitions constitute a well-established and extensively studied area of research with numerous generalizations arising from imposing restrictions on the allowed colors of the parts. In particular, restricted colored partitions have received considerable attention owing to their rich combinatorial and arithmetic properties.
